_meta.purpose: Music discovery sources for an agent. Each source has a feed type (rss/api/scrape/manual), a URL or endpoint, a relevance score for the user's taste profile, and tags indicating genre coverage.
_meta.relevance_scoring: 1-10 scale based on overlap with user taste profile. 10=perfect match, 7-9=strong match, 5-6=partial match (worth checking), <5=tangential

feed_types.api_json: JSON REST API with structured response
feed_types.scrape: No native feed, must scrape HTML

tier_1_critical_publications.name: Pitchfork - Best New Albums
tier_1_critical_publications.description: The benchmark for indie/alt critical acclaim. Best New Music designation drives discovery.
tier_1_critical_publications.user_taste_match_notes: Almost every artist in user playlist (Cut Copy, IDLES, Caribou, Fat Dog) has been reviewed here. The single most important source.

tier_1_critical_publications.name: Pitchfork - All Album Reviews
tier_1_critical_publications.description: All album reviews (broader than Best New Music). Useful for tracking specific artists.

tier_1_critical_publications.name: Pitchfork - Lists & Guides
tier_1_critical_publications.description: Year-end lists, decade lists, genre primers. Critical for December roundup.

tier_1_critical_publications.name: The Quietus - Reviews
tier_1_critical_publications.description: UK-based, more experimental and ensayistic than Pitchfork. Strong on post-punk, electronic experimental, metal, krautrock. Independent publication.
tier_1_critical_publications.user_taste_match_notes: Perfect for the user's post-punk and experimental electronic side. Has dedicated columns: Album of the Week, Reissue of the Week, Metal, Psych Rock, Punk, Rum Music (avant), Cassettes, New Weird Britain, Electronic, International. Note: feed URL needs verification — try /feed/, /rss/, /reviews/feed/.

tier_1_critical_publications.name: Stereogum - All Reviews
tier_1_critical_publications.description: Album reviews including weekly Album of the Week. Less pretentious than Pitchfork, very strong on US indie.

tier_1_critical_publications.name: Stereogum - Main Feed
tier_1_critical_publications.description: All site content. High volume — apply genre/keyword filtering.

tier_1_critical_publications.name: Resident Advisor - Album Reviews
tier_1_critical_publications.description: The gold standard for serious electronic music criticism. RA has confirmed RSS feeds for News, Features, Album Reviews and Single Reviews.
tier_1_critical_publications.user_taste_match_notes: Perfect for the Caribou / Maribou State / Cut Copy side. Verify feed URL — RA has confirmed feeds exist but URL pattern needs testing.

tier_1_critical_publications.name: The Guardian - Music
tier_1_critical_publications.description: Best mainstream UK music journalism. Alexis Petridis is a top pop/rock critic. Strong on UK post-punk new waves.

tier_1_critical_publications.name: The Guardian - Music Blog
tier_1_critical_publications.description: Opinion and discovery pieces. Curated lists.

tier_1_critical_publications.name: NME - News & Reviews
tier_1_critical_publications.description: British indie/alternative coverage. Strong on new UK bands (Fat Dog territory).

tier_2_radio_curators.name: NTS Radio - Live API
tier_2_radio_curators.description: Public (undocumented) JSON API showing current and upcoming shows on NTS's two channels with metadata, genres, location, descriptions.
tier_2_radio_curators.user_taste_match_notes: World's most influential alternative radio. Programs are curated by humans with serious taste. The API gives now-playing and upcoming shows; archives available via Mixcloud and SoundCloud. Use for show metadata; tracklists not always exposed in API but visible on show pages.
tier_2_radio_curators.implementation_notes: Returns JSON with channel_name, broadcast_title, start/end timestamps, genres, location, description, picture URL. No auth required.

tier_2_radio_curators.name: NTS Radio - Latest Shows
tier_2_radio_curators.description: Daily-updated archive of newest broadcasts. No native RSS — scrape required.

tier_2_radio_curators.name: NTS Radio - Curated Collections
tier_2_radio_curators.description: Themed collections curated by NTS staff. Examples: krautrock, post-punk, Bristol bass, Japanese underground, Iranian music. Goldmine for genre-specific deep dives.

tier_2_radio_curators.name: NTS Radio - Infinite Mixtapes
tier_2_radio_curators.description: 24/7 themed audio streams: Slow Focus (post-punk/new wave), Poolside (balearic), Low Key (lo-fi hip-hop/R&B), Memory Lane (oddball post-punk + industrial + minimal wave). NOT a feed — direct streaming.
tier_2_radio_curators.user_taste_match_notes: The 'Memory Lane' (oddball post-punk, industrial, minimal wave) and 'Slow Focus' streams are direct hits for user taste. 'Poolside' matches the Maribou State / Cut Copy chill side.

tier_2_radio_curators.name: BBC Radio 6 Music - Schedule
tier_2_radio_curators.description: BBC's alternative music station. Hosts 2025: Nick Grimshaw (Breakfast), Lauren Laverne (mid-morning, returned 2025 after cancer treatment), Mary Anne Hobbs (returns spring 2025 with new show), Iggy Pop (Saturday nights), Steve Lamacq (indie), Gilles Peterson (jazz/groove). No public RSS for shows but tracklists scrapable per episode.
tier_2_radio_curators.user_taste_match_notes: Mary Anne Hobbs's show is the closest match for the user's experimental electronic + ambient side. Steve Lamacq for post-punk/indie. Listen-again via BBC Sounds (geo-restricted to UK without VPN, but tracklists are public).
tier_2_radio_curators.implementation_notes: BBC Sounds is geo-locked to UK. Track metadata and now-playing data is exposed at https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/{programme_id}.json — try this for individual shows.

tier_2_radio_curators.name: BBC Radio 6 Music - Recommends Playlist (Spotify mirror)
tier_2_radio_curators.description: Fan-maintained Spotify playlist mirroring Lauren Laverne's BBC 6 Music selections (10,943+ tracks). Not official.

tier_2_radio_curators.name: Radar 97.8 FM Lisboa - Esta Semana (programas)
tier_2_radio_curators.description: Lisbon-based alternative radio. Weekly programme highlights ('Observatório RADAR' for albums, 'Palco RADAR' for live, 'Discopátria' for PT artists). Context source only: programme themes, not a reliable track feed.
tier_2_radio_curators.user_taste_match_notes: Good local/editorial context, but the feed describes weekly programme themes and yielded 0 safe track candidates in validation.
tier_2_radio_curators.implementation_notes: Do not add to playlist automatically. Treat as context/report source with a small weekly cap.

tier_2_radio_curators.name: Radar 97.8 FM - Spotify Playlist
tier_2_radio_curators.description: Fan-maintained Spotify playlist tracking what Radar plays (1486+ tracks, 2.6K saves).

tier_2_radio_curators.name: Radar 97.8 FM - Podcast Feed (Podbean)
tier_2_radio_curators.description: Podcast versions of Radar's curated programs (RADAR Beats, Atacama Blues, Discopátria, etc.). Large historical backlog; context only.
tier_2_radio_curators.implementation_notes: Podcast feed exposes a large historical backlog. Do not add to playlist automatically; report context only.

tier_2_radio_curators.name: KEXP - Song of the Day Podcast
tier_2_radio_curators.description: Daily (Mon-Fri) curated track from KEXP DJs. Covers indie, alt, world, electronic, latin. Each episode = one track + context.

tier_2_radio_curators.name: KEXP - In Our Headphones Podcast
tier_2_radio_curators.description: Weekly podcast where KEXP DJs share songs they can't stop listening to, with context.

tier_2_radio_curators.name: KEXP Live Sessions (YouTube)
tier_2_radio_curators.description: Live in-studio sessions. Industry-standard quality. Khruangbin, IDLES, etc. all appeared. 3.5M YouTube subscribers.

tier_3_aggregators_metacritic.name: Album of the Year (AOTY) - RSS Hub
tier_3_aggregators_metacritic.description: Aggregator of music critic scores from 50+ publications. Cross-references Pitchfork, Rolling Stone, NME, Guardian, Quietus. Best for tracking critical consensus.
tier_3_aggregators_metacritic.implementation_notes: Native RSS available at /rss/ but limited. For programmatic access, use unofficial Python package 'album-of-the-year-api' on PyPI (web-scraping wrapper). Cloudflare protection on direct scraping.

tier_3_aggregators_metacritic.name: Metacritic - Music
tier_3_aggregators_metacritic.description: Aggregates album reviews from professional critics into Metascores. No native RSS; community-built scrapers exist (e.g., github.com/claytono/metacritic-rss).

tier_3_aggregators_metacritic.name: AnyDecentMusic - Critic Aggregator
tier_3_aggregators_metacritic.description: UK-focused aggregator. Tracks 50+ publications including Quietus, Drowned in Sound, NME. No native RSS.

tier_4_substack_newsletters.name: First Floor by Shawn Reynaldo
tier_4_substack_newsletters.description: Best long-form electronic music newsletter. Industry analysis + recommendations.

tier_4_substack_newsletters.name: Hear Hear by Adam Offitzer
tier_4_substack_newsletters.description: Aggregates year-end lists from major critics; spotlights underrated artists. Especially useful in December.

tier_4_substack_newsletters.name: Cabbages Hip Hop
tier_4_substack_newsletters.description: Underground/alternative hip-hop with deep listening. Author processes hundreds of releases yearly.
tier_4_substack_newsletters.user_taste_match_notes: User wants Drake-tier mainstream PLUS lyrically-driven alt rap. Cabbages covers the latter superbly.

tier_4_substack_newsletters.name: The Honest Broker by Ted Gioia
tier_4_substack_newsletters.description: Cultural music criticism with industry depth. Covers beyond indie.

tier_4_substack_newsletters.name: Indie Scientist
tier_4_substack_newsletters.description: Indie/post-punk recommendations weekly. Strong taste overlap with user profile.

tier_4_substack_newsletters.name: Recent and Decent by Matt Bull
tier_4_substack_newsletters.description: Weekly playlist of 7 new tracks across genres.

tier_4_substack_newsletters.name: Natural Music
tier_4_substack_newsletters.description: Genre-spanning recommendations with serious depth (post-punk, glitch, jangle, ambient, hyperpop).

tier_5_supporting_sources.name: Brooklyn Vegan
tier_5_supporting_sources.description: NYC-centric, multi-genre music blog. High volume — useful for catching news fast.

tier_5_supporting_sources.name: The FADER

tier_5_supporting_sources.name: Line of Best Fit

tier_5_supporting_sources.name: FACT Magazine
tier_5_supporting_sources.description: Electronic music and underground culture. UK-based.

tier_5_supporting_sources.name: Mixmag

tier_5_supporting_sources.description: Editorial covering Bandcamp releases. Strong for genre deep dives ('Best of...' lists by genre monthly).

tier_5_supporting_sources.name: Drowned in Sound
tier_5_supporting_sources.description: UK indie webzine, reactivated. Good for underground UK indie.

tier_6_hip_hop_specific.name: HipHopDX - Reviews
tier_6_hip_hop_specific.description: Mainstream + underground rap reviews. Includes Drake-tier coverage user requested.

tier_6_hip_hop_specific.name: Complex - Music
tier_6_hip_hop_specific.description: Mainstream rap and pop culture intersection. Annual best-of lists are standard reference. In 2025 noted that rap had its weakest chart year in three decades — they cover both mainstream Drake and underground.

tier_6_hip_hop_specific.name: Pigeons & Planes
tier_6_hip_hop_specific.description: Discovery-focused; emerging artists across rap, indie, electronic.

tier_6_hip_hop_specific.name: Passion of the Weiss
tier_6_hip_hop_specific.description: Long-form, literary writing on rap. High-quality essays.

recommended_workflow: 1. STARTUP: Fetch all RSS feeds tagged fetch_priority=high. Cache for 6 hours.
2. FILTER: Match incoming items against user_taste_profile.examples_from_user (artist mentions) and primary genres.
3. SCORE: Assign relevance score = source.relevance * (1 + 0.5 if user-named artist mentioned) * recency_decay.
4. DEDUPLICATE: Group items by album/artist; merge mentions across sources to indicate consensus.
5. SURFACE: Present top 10 items per week, with source attribution and a 1-sentence why-this-matches.
6. WEEKLY DIGEST: Combine Pitchfork BNM + Stereogum AOTW + Quietus AOTW + RA Album Review + Radar Observatório.
7. DECEMBER MODE: Switch to year-end aggregation. Pull AOTY rss + all 'best of' lists, intersect for consensus picks.
quality_filters: Reject items where genre tags include only: country, christian, mainstream-pop-only, EDM-festival
Boost items with genre tags: post-punk, indie-electronic, alternative-rap, ambient, krautrock
Boost items mentioning Cut Copy, Caribou, Khruangbin neighborhood (electronic-melodic crossover)

consensus_signals.strong_buy: Mentioned positively in 3+ Tier 1 sources within 7 days

anti_patterns: Don't surface every Pitchfork review — filter by Best New Music or 7.8+ score
Don't surface aggregator-only mentions without primary source verification
Don't trust Spotify-algorithm playlists alone — they mirror what user already likes
